lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: Commander Holt to all ships. I have the fleet now, General, and we end this today.

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: Isolde's home fleet is dug in around the throne world. We break through it, then we bring down her Flagship.

lines.speaker: ryn
lines.text: My father believed in you. Show me he was right.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: No admiral to save you this time, Arden.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Enough. You have burned my fleet and reached my throne, Arden. I taught you well.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: So, General. What will you do with me now?

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: You're outnumbered, Isolde. Surrender, and come home to your people.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Come home? To you? I am home, traitor. I will burn with my throne before I kneel to what I made.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: No more offers. This ends with your Flagship.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Then come and take it, General. I am the Sovereignty, and I do not break.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: My finest general... Remember, Arden. I made you.
